findings.text: S-2 AC1 checks Cancelled exclusion only when every future appointment is Cancelled. It does not check that a Cancelled appointment earlier than a Scheduled one is skipped, which REQ-6 together with REQ-2 requires.

rubric_items.reason: All 12 known REQs and assumed REQ-13 are traced: S-1 covers REQ-1..5, S-2 covers REQ-6..7, S-3 covers REQ-8, S-4 covers REQ-13 and S-5 covers REQ-9..12.
Stories are mostly single-outcome. S-5 groups four regression constraints (paging, search, sort, privacy), and S-1 groups five REQs, but both still deliver one coherent outcome each.

Every AC is in Given/When/Then form. S-1 AC3 has no exact expected format (U-1), and S-2 AC1 tests Cancelled only when Cancelled is the patient's only future appointment, not when a Cancelled one comes before a Scheduled one.
The values (20 per page, Asia/Kolkata, "None", the column title) all come from the intent. S-3 AC2 (None is not a link) and the Q-04 'Hide the name' option are inferred, not stated in the intent.
Clear, consistent terms that match the glossary. Body and frontmatter agree, and the Known/Assumed/Unknown sections are well organized.
